paper.title: On the Minimax Regret for Linear Bandits in a wide variety of Action Spaces

settings.name_in_paper: Linear bandit on the L^p ball (lower bound)
settings.definition_quote: Let $\cX$ be the $L^p$ ball defined as $\cX = \{ x \in \Real^d \; : \norm{x}_p \leq c \}$, where $1 < p < \infty$.

symbols.c_rad: radius c of the L^p ball action set
symbols.p_ball: order p of the L^p ball, 1 < p < infinity

conditions: action set is the L^p ball {x : ||x||_p <= c_rad} with 1 < p_ball < infinity
d <= (2 c_rad n^2)^(p_ball/2) as stated in the theorem (the proof uses d <= (2 n c_rad^2)^(p_ball/2))
hard instance theta in {+Delta,-Delta}^d with ||theta||_p^p = d^2 / ((4 sqrt(3) c_rad)^p n^(p/2))
unit-variance Gaussian noise (implicit in the KL computation, following Lattimore & Szepesvari Ch. 24)

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Let $\cX$ be the $L^p$ ball defined as $\cX = \{ x \in \Real^d \; : \norm{x}_p \leq c \}$, where $1 < p < \infty$. Assume $d \leq (2cn^2)^\frac{p}{2}$. Then there exists a parameter $\theta \in \Real^d$ with $\norm{\theta}_p^p = \frac{1}{(c4\sqrt{3})^p}\frac{d^2}{n^{\frac{p}{2}}}$ such that $\cR_n(\theta) \geq \frac{d\sqrt{n}}{16\sqrt{3}}$.

results.notes: The paper does not state the noise model explicitly. The KL step matches unit Gaussian noise, as in Lattimore & Szepesvari Section 24.2. The regret is defined via x*^T theta - x_t^T theta, which I read as expected (pseudo) regret. The assumption on d is written inconsistently: (2cn^2)^{p/2} in the theorem and (2nc^2)^{p/2} in the proof. The parameter norm of the hard instance depends on n, so the bound does not hold under a fixed bound S on the parameter norm.
